name: Milton S'mores with Santa at American Legion Post 78
paras: American Legion Post 78 hosts its 5th Annual S'mores with Santa on Friday, December 4, from 5:30 to 7:30 PM at 6025 Spikes Way in Milton. The post describes turning its corner of Milton into the North Pole for the whole community.

Families can take a hayride through the wooded grounds past lighted inflatable Christmas decorations, visit Santa for pictures, decorate a cookie and make a Christmas craft. A fire pit is set up for s'mores, with hot cider and hot chocolate on hand.

The listing also names popcorn and hot dogs, raffle baskets and a 50/50 raffle by donation. The event is free and open to the community, and the post invites kids, parents, grandparents, veterans, friends and neighbors.
tip: Dress for an outdoor evening, since the hayride and the fire pit are outside.

name: Navarre Christmas in the Park and Merry Market
host: Navarre Beach Area Chamber of Commerce
paras: The Navarre Beach Area Chamber of Commerce holds the 32nd Annual Christmas in the Park and Merry Market on Saturday, December 5, from 10 AM to 4 PM at Navarre Park, 8513 Navarre Parkway. The chamber lists the event as free and open to the public.

Kids get Candy Cane Lane, where local businesses and groups set up booths with free games, crafts, decorating and prizes. Mrs. Claus' Bakery serves free baked goods and hot beverages, and area school groups, church choirs and local performers take the stage from 10 AM to 4 PM.

The Navarre Community Christmas Parade steps off at 1 PM from the Navarre Library. Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch head to Navarre Park after the parade for free photos, so bring a camera. The Navarre Chamber Foundation also lists a Jingle Bell Run at 8 AM that morning.
tip: Bring your own camera for the free photos with Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch after the parade.
